description: Build a contributor-query response: given a signed SettlementRecord and a contributor DID, return per-axis (total_weight, contribution_count, merkle_path, axis_root) plus the full signed record so a third party can verify the contributor's share end-to-end without trusting the gateway beyond its public key. Returns null if the contributor has no share in the period.

contributor_did.description: Contributor DID (data source, compute provider, governance signer, or protocol module identifier)

gateway_jwks.description: Advisory JWKS URL; not part of the signed material

name: aps_build_contributor_query
